details: Bitcoin traded near $83,000 on Tuesday, influenced by rising US Treasury yields, a stronger dollar, and uncertainty surrounding the US midterm elections. Spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded significant outflows last week, signaling cautious institutional sentiment. The crypto Fear and Greed Index slipped to 53.
title: Bitcoin Dips Amid Geopolitical Uncertainty, ETF Outflows

details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) warned on Tuesday of significant growth and financial stability risks. These include a potential end to the AI investment boom, growing debt levels, and a prolonged Middle East conflict. The IMF forecasts global growth at 3.1% for 2026.
title: IMF Flags Global Economy Risks from AI Correction, Debt, Middle East Conflict

details: Market attention is turning to Wednesday's US inflation report. Headline inflation is expected at 3.7% and core inflation at 2.5%. A softer-than-expected reading could alleviate pressure on bond yields and provide renewed momentum for cryptocurrency markets.
title: US Inflation Report Looms: Key Data for Crypto Market Direction
